description: Karachi Style Fish Fry is a beloved Pakistani delicacy, known for its incredibly crispy exterior and tender, succulent interior. Each piece of fish is generously coated in a vibrant, spiced gram flour batter, delivering an explosion of tangy and spicy flavors. This recipe brings the authentic taste of Karachi's coastal cuisine right to your home kitchen.

ingredients.item: White fish fillets (e.g., Red Snapper, Pomfret, Kingfish)
ingredients.notes: cut into medium pieces, washed and pat dry

instructions.title: Prepare the Fish
instructions.text: Wash the fish pieces thoroughly and pat them completely dry with paper towels. Make shallow slits on the thicker parts of the fish to allow the marinade to penetrate deeply. Set aside.

instructions.title: Make the Marinade Paste
instructions.text: In a large bowl, combine ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice, red chili powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, garam masala powder, carom seeds, and salt. Mix well to form a thick paste. If adding, stir in chopped green chilies.

instructions.title: Marinate the Fish
instructions.text: Add the fish pieces to the spice paste. Using your hands, ensure each piece is thoroughly coated with the marinade. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or preferably 2-3 hours for best flavor.

instructions.title: Prepare the Batter
instructions.text: Just before frying, add gram flour and rice flour to the marinated fish. Gradually add water, a tablespoon at a time, mixing until a thick, uniform batter coats the fish pieces. The batter should be just enough to cling to the fish, not too runny.

instructions.title: Heat the Oil
instructions.text: Heat cooking oil in a large deep pan or wok over medium-high heat. To test if the oil is ready, drop a tiny bit of batter; it should sizzle and float to the surface immediately. Ensure the oil is hot but not smoking.

instructions.title: Fry the Fish
instructions.text: Carefully place a few marinated fish pieces into the hot oil, ensuring not to overcrowd the pan. Fry for 4-6 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy. The fish should be cooked through and flaky. Remove the fried fish with a slotted spoon and place on a wire rack or paper towels to drain excess oil.

instructions.title: Serve Hot
instructions.text: Repeat the frying process with the remaining fish pieces. Garnish the freshly fried Karachi Style Fish Fry with chopped fresh cilantro and serve immediately with lemon wedges, mint chutney, or tamarind chutney.

tips: For the crispiest fish, ensure your fish is completely dry before marinating and that your oil is at the right temperature (around 175-180°C or 350-360°F).
Do not overcrowd the frying pan; fry in batches to maintain oil temperature and ensure even cooking and crispiness.
Serve immediately for the best taste and texture. Pair with a fresh salad, raita, or a squeeze of fresh lemon juice to enhance the flavors.
